title: RLL Climate Multiphysics Registry and Scheduler
scope: Govern the existing 8x8 climate registry, source catalog, deterministic scheduler and receipts without claiming validated forecasting skill.

limitations: The recorded local receipt predates final hardening commits and is not a final-tree receipt.
Raw source hydration, parsing and normalization into operational tiles are incomplete.
Predictive skill and superiority over reference models have not been demonstrated.

data_governance.retention: Append-only receipts; raw payload retention follows source license and storage policy.
data_governance.update_policy: Each source adapter must declare cadence, semantic mapping, transformation and failure mode.

security.secrets: Not required by default; authenticated sources require explicit review.
security.incident_record: Record source, revision, failure class, payload hash if available and containment action.

metrics.definition: Fraction of source variables with explicit raw-to-canonical mapping
Valid canonical cells divided by expected cells
Skill difference against a declared reference model on identical data

acceptance_criteria: No forecast claim is promoted without benchmark evidence
rejection_criteria: Source endpoint does not provide declared variable
claim_allowed becomes true without evidence gate
quality.change_control: Pull request with objective, evidence, risks, regression analysis, rollback and updated receipt.

risks.description: Semantic mismatch between endpoint payload and canonical variable
risks.treatment: Fail closed until adapter mapping is tested

risks.description: Missing values collapse into valid normalized zero
Research prototype interpreted as operational warning system

rollback.trigger: Schema regression, source semantic failure, integrity failure or unsupported claim promotion.
rollback.procedure: Revert the responsible commit or disable the affected source/module while preserving receipts.
rollback.verification: Re-run deterministic tests and compare registry and receipt hashes.

f_next: Implement one end-to-end source adapter with explicit semantics and units
Run historical benchmark against declared baselines
